about: The troll standing, a 6 s loop of two slow breaths, keyed on its own 4 m body (D588, docs/keyed-moves.md's small loop), put into troll.glb by the build's creature:troll step (bodies.json `keyed`), before the blows that start on it. Nothing is kept of the take it replaces (a person's idle from Kimodo: the trunk 20 degrees backward, the belly out, the hands behind the hips): its guard is the body as bound, `start` hunches it (the hips tipped forward and set back and down over bent knees, the chest pitched on over them, the head low and looking ahead from under its brow), `rest_arm` hangs the long arms from the shoulders, which the hunch carries ahead of the belly, and each knee is pointed out over its toes. Each breath lifts the chest and the shoulders and lets them down; the weight leans a little to its left in the first and its right in the second; the feet never move. No pose sheet was drawn: keyed from the brief (troll-blows j4, 2026-11-09) and looked at on the workbench's sheet. The breath's length (3 s) is a GUESS (D654): slow for a large animal at rest, not read from a shipped game. Metres, degrees, seconds; places are [right, up, forward] from the model's origin.
name: Troll_Idle
